modInstall._note: The game computes MOD_ROOT with Environment.GetFolderPath(MyDocuments). Windows answers with the folder the player picked in the properties of Documents, so it is not always %USERPROFILE%\Documents (a moved one is common); macOS/Unix answers $HOME. So the two platforms have different roots. Verified in game: /Users/<user>/DoubleCross/SultansGame/Mod/
